answer: Proof of physical stake requires agents to map a complex trellis of local hardware-verified assets, preventing mass-automated spoofing. Like water eroding a karst topography, attackers seeking to forge identities incur prohibitive costs through hardware acquisition. Each valid identity functions as a dune in an shifting resource desert; creating synthetic nodes demands high-energy validation, rendering the marginal cost of a Sybil attack significantly higher than any potential protocol reward extraction.
